rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to say that someone puts others before themselves.

example.english: They always think of others first; they are truly selfless.
example.traditional: 佢成日先諗人哋，真係唔自私。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sin1 nam2 jan4 dei6 zan1 hai6 m4 zi6 si1

rows.note: Use this concise adjective when praising someone’s general lack of self-interest, especially in a more elevated context.

example.traditional: 大家都讚揚佢無私嘅奉獻。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 zaan3 joeng4 keoi5 mou4 si1 ge3 fung6 hin3

rows.note: Use this idiom when someone actively sacrifices their own interests for other people.

example.english: To save the child, they were selfless and risked rushing into the burning building.
example.traditional: 為咗救個細路，佢捨己為人，冒險衝入火場。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 gau3 go3 sai3 lou6 keoi5 se2 gei2 wai6 jan4 mou6 him2 cung1 jap6 fo2 coeng4
